limits: This is a method verification on an authored fixture: k=3 invented studies with identical variances. It says nothing about the engine's behaviour on real data, on unequal variances, or on larger syntheses.

The fixture is small by construction, so the engine's own diagnostics flag few studies (notice), considerable heterogeneity (warning) and that small-study tests were not run (notice); these are properties of the fixture, not findings about any literature.
The engine did not report a pooled standard error; none is inferred or back-filled in this receipt.
The engine artifact is a snapshot of this one run and was read once at its terminal state; later reruns of the same request id are outside the scope of this verification.

The engine's declared outputDigest could not be tied to the artifact file's sha256, and no explanation for the difference was established here; the artifact bytes are pinned instead by the sha256 the terminal status returned alongside it.
No external evidence was retrieved for this verification and none is cited; there is no clinical claim here to verify against literature.
